no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and keeps only its own rows (kept-apart, [object Object]) through the records door.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Settle a record two of my devices changed apart: keep one version, keep both, or keep a merged one", and give it id (The record kept apart, as the read names it); keep; thing_type (The kind of record whose versions to read or settle (one kind per call; other_kinds names the rest)); request_key (Names this change, so sending it again changes nothing twice).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:settle-two-versions and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Writes what you chose for one record kept apart (id, from see-if-my-copies-are-in-step): keep one (side, the id of the version to keep), both (each other version is kept as a record of its own, named after it with -kept- and a number that no record holds yet), or merged (value, the merged record).
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: kept-apart (records:read, records:write); [object Object] (records:read, records:write).
